Title: Ayaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ayaan - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Anita - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Riya - 9 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Vimla - 73 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Kavya - 10 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The classroom - a blackboard, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ayaan bursts out laughing.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan starts crying.]

Ayaan: "Yes, all right."

[Ayaan smiles at Mother.]

Ayaan (gently): "That's great!"

[Ayaan stamps his foot in anger.]

Ayaan: "Hey, look at that!"

[Ayaan gets frightened and steps back.]

Anita (happily): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The classroom - Day

Ayaan: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan raises his hand to answer.]

Anita: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan writes on the blackboard.]

Ayaan (softly): "That's easy."

[Ayaan reads his book at his desk.]

Ayaan: "Really?"

[Ayaan yawns in the class.]

Ayaan: "What a day to remember!"
